functions.description: Extract base fields: timestamp, hostname, pid, severity, and message from esxtokend log line
Extract user field from message, handling both quoted and key=value formats
Extract IPv4 source address anywhere in the message text
Extract IPv6 source address enclosed in brackets when present
Classify action from message content, normalize severity, and derive _time from timestamp

add.name: action
add.value: message.match(/issued/i) ? 'token_issued' : message.match(/validation failed/i) ? 'validation_failed' : message.match(/successfully validated/i) ? 'validated' : message.match(/renew/i) ? 'renewal_failed' : message.match(/revoked/i) ? 'revoked' : message.match(/brute force|repeated failed/i) ? 'brute_force_detected' : message.match(/unusual IP/i) ? 'suspicious_request' : message.match(/cache cleared/i) ? 'cache_cleared' : message.match(/malformed|unable to parse/i) ? 'parse_error' : message.match(/clock skew/i) ? 'clock_skew_detected' : message.match(/tampering|signature verification failed/i) ? 'tampering_detected' : message.match(/refresh succeeded/i) ? 'token_refreshed' : message.match(/unreachable/i) ? 'store_unreachable' : 'unknown'
